pieces.Text: As a standard action, you can issue an inspiring command to an ally. The inspiring command affects one ally who must be within 30 feet of you. The affected ally gains a +2 insight bonus on attack rolls, AC, combat maneuver defense, and skill checks for 1 round. This is a language-dependant mind-affecting effect.
As a standard action, you can issue an inspiring command to your allies. The inspiring command affects

allies, who must all be within 30 feet of you. Affected allies gain a +2 insight bonus on attack rolls, AC, combat maneuver defense, and skill checks for 1 round. This is a language-dependant mind-affecting effect.
